title: Are you using the wrong instrument for your strategy?
subtitle: Are swaps, spreads, and hidden commissions eating into your returns? Simulate your trading profile using our real cost database and find which broker and instrument combination best protects your edge.
trust: TradeScope compares execution cost, holding cost, and ticket cost before producing the final ranking.
visual_note: The same underlying can become radically more or less efficient once the holding profile changes.
monitor_intraday_note: Most drag comes from execution quality and turnover.
monitor_multiday_note: Swap stops being marginal and becomes structural.
monitor_position_note: Holding cost can cancel an otherwise valid setup.
